estimand: mean drop from the clean IO-versus-subject logit difference over the held-out prompt distribution under a fixed multi-head mean ablation
intervention_family: binary subsets of Name Movers, Backup Name Movers, and Negative Name Movers ablated at the final token
known_scope_limits: The task uses one pinned GPT-2-small checkpoint and the documented IOI head groups.
Measurements and targets are prompt-averaged; the task does not expose prompt-level outcomes.
The task evaluates effect prediction, not mechanism discovery or behavioral safety.
measurement_design: first 160 masks in the frozen nested calibration order; each observed effect averages 192 disjoint train prompts
summary: Predict the held-out mean finite change in the IOI logit difference after template-conditioned mean ablation of a fixed subset of 13 documented heads.
validation_target: mean effects for 320 held-out candidate masks, each averaged over 256 disjoint test prompts
